summary: Rumble Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of transactions under a Business Combination Agreement dated November 10, 2025, with Northern Data AG (target), alongside transaction support agreements with Tether Investments, ART Holding GmbH, and Apeiron Investment Group. The deal closed on June 17, 2026. Specific terms (price per share, premium) are not disclosed in the excerpt. The board recommended the transaction; advisors are unnamed. The filing notes an amended registration rights agreement with Tether. Regulatory clock is closed as the transaction is completed. What to watch: integration risk and potential share overhang from Tether's registration rights.
